records.title: Tvara Community
records.description: Long-running autonomous AI engagement agent combining persistent state, event-driven execution, scheduled workflows, retrieval-based context and LLM reasoning for continuous community management. Identifies engagement opportunities from ongoing activity and generates context-aware responses without manual intervention.

records.title: Real Estate Discovery Agent — Obeya Smart Workspaces
records.description: Autonomous discovery pipeline aggregating heterogeneous web data for commercial properties and prospects, with information extraction, lead qualification, contextual matching and prioritization across hundreds of properties and leads.

records.title: Guunj — Community Activity Engagement Agent
records.description: AI-driven engagement agent automating event discovery, outreach, participant tracking and coordination across 20+ events serving 1,200+ participants.

records.title: 2D Game Engine
records.description: Lightweight 2D game engine built from scratch with reusable systems for game loops, rendering, input, collision detection, scenes, entities, asset management and object lifecycle, structured around reusable components for iterative gameplay development.
